shared.q: How do the 4 Band plan seats work?
shared.a: The account holder offers 4 seats to friends or members of their bands. Each guest accepts and gets the full Band plan. If the holder cancels, guests go back to the Free plan at the end of the holder's billing period, and their bands become read-only 30 days later.

change.q: Can I change plans at any time?
change.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade whenever you like. Proration is calculated automatically.

refund.q: How do refunds work if I downgrade?
refund.a: If you move to a lower plan, the difference is credited to your next invoice. The change takes effect immediately.

cancel.q: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: You keep access to all paid features until the end of your billing period. After that, you go back to the Free plan.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: All major cards are accepted (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through our secure partner Stripe.
